blocks.text: Amorphous solids, crystalline solids ke ulat, regular three-dimensional geometrical shakal nahi rakhte. Misalein: glass (sheesha), wood (lakri), amorphous sulphur (plastic sulphur), charcoal, coal, coke waghera.
